basic_info.description: Welcome to 2243 Francisco Street, a beautifully remodeled full-floor condominium in the heart of San Francisco's Marina District. Just steps from Chestnut Street, the Palace of Fine Arts, Crissy Field, Union Street, and Fort Mason, this residence combines timeless period details with modern comfort in one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods. This 2-bedroom, 2-bath home offers a bright open floor plan with south-facing windows and a private balcony overlooking the garden. The chef's kitchen with stainless appliances and premium finishes flows into the dining room and a spacious living room with wood-burning fireplaceperfect for everyday living and entertaining. Two spacious bedrooms with ample closets pair with modern bathrooms and in-unit laundry. Hardwood floors and classic Marina details add charm, while a landscaped shared garden with apple and lemon trees provides a serene retreat. Additional features include a seismically upgraded garage with easy side-by-side parking (or optional 2-car tandem) and a private storage room. 2243 Francisco is more than a homeit's a lifestyle. With world-class shopping, dining, and recreation just outside your door, this is a rare opportunity to own in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods.
